model_system: G-type antiferromagnetic cubic perovskite KNiF3 (2×2×2 supercell), without SOC, pumped by linearly polarized light
headline_claim: Linearly polarized ultrafast light induces nonequilibrium altermagnetic spin splitting in KNiF3; the associated valence-band anomalous Hall conductivity peak oscillates between ±400 S/cm and persists for 1 ps.
replication_difficulty: high - requires nonadiabatic real-time TDDFT with coupled lattice dynamics and symmetry-resolved postprocessing of spin splitting/AHC.
